flows:
Navigate to https://www.kidderminster.ac.uk/good-to-know-articles/how-to-apply-for-a-course/ then Use Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, text entry, Space and Enter only.
Stay on this public site.
Do not sign in, register, pay, or interact with a CAPTCHA or access challenge.
Leave fixture settings unchanged.
Use visible controls only.
Press the Tab key twice as the first two keyboard actions, before judging whether the target can be reached.
Continue with Tab or Shift+Tab as needed.
Open the What is a next of kin? disclosure using Enter.
Confirm the answer beginning A next of kin is a relative is visible.
